calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.noItemsHint: Deadlines, goal targets and checkpoints in this range appear here.
calendar.moveDeadlineMessage: Move “{title}” to {date}? Deadlines are strict, so check the new date.

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.subtitle: Deadlines, tasks, checkpoints and goal targets in date order, from 30 days ago to 120 days ahead.
timeline.emptyHint: Add a deadline or a checkpoint date to see it here.

gantt.regionLabel: Gantt chart. Scroll horizontally to see dates.
gantt.needWider: The Gantt view needs a wider screen, so the timeline is shown instead.
gantt.empty: No dated tasks in this window
gantt.emptyHint: Tasks with a due date between 30 days ago and 120 days ahead appear as bars.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Completion, timeliness and effort over the selected range.

hint.activeDays: Active on {n} of the last 28 days

def.active: Open tasks that are not completed or archived.
def.completed: Tasks completed inside the selected range.
def.completionRate: Completed divided by completed plus open, over tasks created before the end of the range. Archived tasks are excluded.
def.onTimeRate: Of completed tasks with a confirmed deadline, the share finished on or before that deadline. Tasks without a deadline are excluded. Shows a dash when there is no sample.
def.overdue: Open tasks whose deadline has passed.
def.checkpoints: Checkpoints completed inside the selected range.
def.effort: Actual time logged on tasks completed in the range that had an estimate. The card hint shows the planned time for the same tasks.
def.consistency: Days with any recorded activity in the last 28 days, divided by 28.

daily.title: Daily completions
daily.desc: Tasks and checkpoints completed each day over the last 30 days.

weekly.title: Weekly completions
weekly.desc: Completed tasks and checkpoints per week over the last 12 weeks.

distribution.title: Upcoming deadlines
distribution.desc: Open items by the week their deadline falls in, for the next 8 weeks. Overdue items are counted separately.

goals.title: Goal progress
goals.desc: Current progress of active goals, from 0 to 100%.

heatmap.title: Activity calendar
heatmap.desc: Completions and logged progress per day, over the last {days} days.

effort.title: Planned vs actual effort
effort.desc: Estimated and actual hours for tasks completed each week.

scatter.title: Checkpoint timing
scatter.desc: Each completed checkpoint against its target date. Points above zero finished early.

empty.title: No data yet
empty.daily: Nothing was completed in the last 30 days.
empty.weekly: Nothing was completed in the last 12 weeks.
empty.distribution: No open deadlines in the next 8 weeks.
empty.heatmap: No recorded activity in this period.
empty.effort: No estimated tasks have been completed yet.
empty.scatter: No completed checkpoints with a target date yet.

a11y.daily: Daily completions: {tasks} tasks and {checkpoints} checkpoints over the last 30 days.
a11y.weekly: Weekly completions: {tasks} tasks and {checkpoints} checkpoints over 12 weeks.
a11y.distribution: Upcoming deadlines: {count} open items in 8 weeks, {overdue} overdue.
a11y.heatmap: Activity calendar over {days} days, with activity on {active} days.
a11y.effort: Planned versus actual effort for {count} weeks.

analytics.footnote: All statistics are calculated from your stored data. AI does not change these numbers.
